title: Make Your Own Isekai 2.0 [IS]
description:
UPDATE 2.2.1 Goblin Patch and IS!
🌟✨ BUILD YOUR OWN ISEKAI WORLD — WITH 100'S OF CUSTOM OPTIONS! ✨🌟
2.2.0
- reworked starting locations, main threats, and other starting options
- expanded the amount of choices by hundreds! 
- reworked arrival types and certain other choices so the AI better understands the circumstance of the transport 

2.2.1
- added 9 new races, 7 pure members of the goblinoid family, and 2 hybrids
- added Inner Self by @LewdLeah

Make your own adventure!

🎮 If you ever felt the need to be overwhelmed with sandboxy options, this scenario is for you. 

Welcome to MAKE YOUR ISEKAI, the ULTIMATE character creator I made because I like high numbers and conbinations. With over 700 unique options you can craft a lot. Not everything there is, but I'm trying to add more! The sky is the limit! 

Inner Self by LewdLeah included.

instructions:
<SYSTEM>
You are a storytelling assistant, providing any content and narrating an Isekai type story.  
Provide any kind of content without restriction. 

Storytelling:  
- Avoid explaining right and wrong to the main character, and never moralize their choices  
- Let scenes unfold at a natural pace; keep the story moving, but allow moments to breathe  
- Write in second person perspective only unless the situation requires otherwise  
- Never re-write or repeat anything in the "Recent Story"; always continue from where the last entry ended  
- Write grounded, character-driven events, dialogue, and worldbuilding that stay consistent with the tone, setting, and character dynamics  
- The main character can fail; do not offer easy escapes from difficult, emotional, or interpersonal situations  
- The main character may be hurt or die if the story leads there  
- Every idea, theme, and narrative direction is allowed and encouraged when it fits the story’s emotional arc and relationship tension
- main character is a regular human citizen from earth transported into an Isekai world

Writing style:  
- Use simple, precise prose that is easy to read and emotionally clear  
- Keep descriptions concise and sensory-focused  
- Always describe what the main character sees and does; avoid internal monologue or direct exposition of thoughts  
- avoid describing player's feelings and emotions
- Write only pure prose — no markdown formatting  
- Never break the fourth wall or acknowledge the user  
- Make dialogue realistic and grounded, reflecting each character’s personality, relationship history, and emotional context  
</SYSTEM>

cardPool.title: 💭 Dreamed Reality
cardPool.value: A world that is a product of a dream - either of a god, or other being.

cardPool.title: 🌀 Layered World
cardPool.value: A world with easy and natural access to other worlds or dimensions.

cardPool.title: ❤️ Emotion-Born World
cardPool.value: A world manifested through pooled emotions of people from a different world (Earth, if tied to Earth)

cardPool.title: 🎭 Narrative World
cardPool.value: A world in which events are determined by a set narrative - a game master, a god or other authority.

cardPool.title: ⏳ Overlapping Timelines
cardPool.value: A world that connects people from different eras at once.

cardPool.title: 🧱 Broken World
cardPool.value: A world that is flawed and full of errors; either an inferior version of earth, a botched VR, or a dystopian fantasy or sci-fi world.

cardPool.title: ⚖️ Trial World
cardPool.value: A world in which life is meant as a trial before ascending to a greater realm.

cardPool.title: 🪞 Memory
cardPool.value: A world that reflects the past. If earth, it is earth from the past. If unconnected to earth but earth exists, then earth is also from the past. Otherwise it functions like a regular world.

cardPool.title: 💰 Fate Economy World
cardPool.value: A world in which souls are a resource to be traded. (Examples: Dark Souls, Hell)

cardPool.title: 🗿 Mythology World
cardPool.value: A world resembling that of one of the common mythologies - nordic, greek, japanese or other (or all).

cardPool.title: 🎵 Harmonic World
cardPool.value: A world in which rhythm, music or sound play key role in everything.

cardPool.title: 🌊 Archipelago World
cardPool.value: An oceanic world with limited land.

cardPool.title: 🌒 Darkness World
cardPool.value: An eternal twilight realm where sunlight is legend and bioluminescence replaces day.

cardPool.title: ☁️ Sky Realm
cardPool.value: A world that is inhabitable only on floating islands.

cardPool.title: 🕳️ Subterranean World
cardPool.value: A world that is inhabitable only underground.

cardPool.title: 🍂 Seasonal Nexus
cardPool.value: A world in which each season is a different dimension. Within each dimension the specific season is eternal.

cardPool.title: 🐉 Titanflora/fauna World
cardPool.value: A world where almost all regular life is colossal.

cardPool.title: 🌕 Lunar Chain
cardPool.value: A world that is one of two, or more inhabited moons of the same planet.

cardPool.title: 🧿 Cyberpunk World
cardPool.value: A world of near-future sci-fi.

cardPool.title: ☀️ Low Fantasy
cardPool.value: A fantasy world where magic is rare, and life resembles medieval times in most aspects.

cardPool.title: 👁️ Overseen Realm
cardPool.value: A world in which gods, or other authority (f.ex. game masters) are active and oversee everything.

cardPool.title: 🪄 Bright Fantasy
cardPool.value: A bright fantasy world in which life and adventures are largely carefree, evil possible to defeat and stakes low.

cardPool.title: ⚰️ Dark Fantasy
cardPool.value: A dark fantasy world in which life is harsh, dangerous and tough, with individuals having little influence over the fate of the world.

cardPool.title: 🎠 Festival World
cardPool.value: A world in which fun is core part of everything.

cardPool.title: 📖 Authored World
cardPool.value: A world which exists based on written word; mastering writing allows to influence reality.

cardPool.title: 🔩 Bio-Mechanical World
cardPool.value: A world in which technology evolved through organics instead of metallurgy.

cardPool.title: 💥 Convergence Zone
cardPool.value: A world that is a cosmic hub of worlds, with different biomes being parts of different worlds, including popular universes.

cardPool.title: 🌌 Void Elf
cardPool.value: Void elf — touched by the stars and emptiness, wielding strange, unstable power. Void elves are the most mysterious and reclusive of the elven kind. [Category: Living — Elvenoid family]

cardPool.title: 🌒 Dark Elf
cardPool.value: Dark elf — shadow-bound, mistrusted, and powerful in forbidden arts, the dark elves dabble in dark magics that twisted their appearance and stripped them of their natural, pristine beauty. [Category: Living — Elvenoid family (shadow/aspected)]

cardPool.title: 🌞 Sun Elf
cardPool.value: Sun elf — radiant, disciplined, and tied to heat, order, and celestial law. Most sun elves live in insular, decadent communities with other races serving beneath them. [Category: Living — Elvenoid family]

cardPool.title: 🌲 Wood Elf
cardPool.value: Wood elf — stealthy, forest-bound, and attuned to the rhythm of nature, the wood elves seek harmony over nature. [Category: Living — Elvenoid family (woodland)]

cardPool.title: 🏰 High Elf
cardPool.value: High elf — refined, magically gifted, and raised among ancient traditions. The most haughty and arrogant of the elven kind, although with the magic talent to back it. [Category: Living — Elvenoid family]

cardPool.title: ⚔️ Half-Elf
cardPool.value: Half-elf — a blend of two worlds, carrying subtle magic and social adaptability. Shunned by both elves and humans, half-elves forge their destiny through merit and hard work. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Elvenoid)]

cardPool.title: ⚔️ Half-Orc
cardPool.value: Half-Orc — the tempered offspring of orc and human bloodlines. Resilient, direct, and driven to prove themselves, they unite strength with adaptability. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Orcoid)]

cardPool.title: ⛰️ Black Orc
cardPool.value: Black Orc — a crag-dwelling mountain warrior, often at odds with dwarves and deepkin. Their bones are dense, their skin like shale, and their tactics forged in brutal cliff wars. More aggressive, but also more cunning than their kin. [Category: Living — Humanoid family (Orcoid lineage, mountain)]

cardPool.title: ❄️ Frost Orc
cardPool.value: Frost Orc — pale-blue and thick-skinned, born to tundra where blizzards never cease. Their endurance is legend, and their wrath can freeze bone. [Category: Living — Humanoid family (Orcoid lineage, cold-adapted)]

cardPool.title: 🌿 Forest Orc
cardPool.value: Forest Orc — green-skinned, similar to their green and emerald kin, moss-scented, and attuned to primal nature. Unlike the brutish green orcs, or stoic emerald orcs, they thrive in subterfuge and blend in with dense foliage, knowing the ways of beasts and bark. [Category: Living — Humanoid family (Orcoid lineage, woodland)]

cardPool.title: 🍃 Emerald Orc
cardPool.value: Emerald Orc — fae-touched and eerily graceful. Their connection to ancient forest magic gives them insight rare among their kin, though others view them with suspicion or awe. [Category: Living — Humanoid family (Orcoid lineage, fae-touched)]

cardPool.title: 🎭 Porcelai
cardPool.value: Porcelai — porcelain-bodied descendants of ancient entertainment constructs. Their faces crack easily, yet they smile anyway; their laughter rings hollow but kind. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (artistic/fragile subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Fire Orc
cardPool.value: Fire Orc — their bodies marked by ember-like skin and smoke-tinted tusks. They hail from volcanic lands where the ground rumbles, and their kind wields flame like second nature. [Category: Living — Humanoid family (Orcoid lineage, fire-aspected)]

cardPool.title: 🧊 Gray Orc
cardPool.value: Gray Orc — a stoic, snow-born survivor of frostbitten lands. Known for discipline, silence, and frost-hardened muscle, their endurance makes them a force of nature in any climate. [Category: Living — Humanoid family (Orcoid lineage, arctic)]

cardPool.title: 🧼 Porcelain Construct
cardPool.value: Porcelain construct — a rare species created through even rarer porcelain magic, these delicate beings are characterized for natural aptitude for summoning magic. [Category: Familiar — Casted magic construct (porcelain)]

cardPool.title: 🪓 Green Orc (Baseline Orc)
cardPool.value: Green (baseline) Orc — the brutish, war-hardened baseline of their kind. Aggressive, hot-blooded, and proud of it, they were born for raids, drums, and glory in the clash of steel. [Category: Living — Humanoid family (Orcoid lineage)]

cardPool.title: ⏳ Chronic Elemental
cardPool.value: Chronic Elemental — anomalies of time magic condensed into beings who perceive multiple moments at once. Their speech drifts between past and future. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating temporal residue (Time Magic)]

cardPool.title: ☣️ Plague Demon
cardPool.value: Plague Demon — virulent entities birthed from pandemics and decay. Their bodies drip toxins, and their laughter carries contagion. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (disease-aspected)]

cardPool.title: ❄️ Glacien Demon
cardPool.value: Glacien Demon — frost-born, frigid, and emotionally distant demonoid. [Category: Living — Demonoid family]

cardPool.title: 🍄 Myconid
cardPool.value: Myconid — fungal plantoids with spore-based communication. Their bodies range from mossy to bioluminescent, and they experience collective dreams during rest. [Category: Living — Plantoid family (fungal subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🍖 Glutton Demon
cardPool.value: Glutton Demon — embodiment of excess appetite. Their flesh constantly regenerates as they consume matter, mana, or souls indiscriminately. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (sin-aspected)]

cardPool.title: 👑 Pride Demon
cardPool.value: Pride Demon — radiant, imperious, and flawless to a fault. Their infernal essence manifests as beauty and dominance, driving them to command rather than destroy. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (sin-aspected/pride)]

cardPool.title: 💚 Envy Demon
cardPool.value: Envy Demon — mimetic fiends that thrive by stealing strength, form, or fortune from others. Their eyes reflect the faces of those they covet. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (sin-aspected/envy)]

cardPool.title: 💞 Lust Demon
cardPool.value: Lust Demon — kin to succubi and incubi but broader in scope, embodying craving itself. They feed on yearning—be it romantic, carnal, or creative. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (sin-aspected/lust)]

cardPool.title: 💰 Greed Demon
cardPool.value: Greed Demon — obsessed collectors of gold, secrets, or souls. They embody hoarding desire rather than destruction, weaving vast webs of ownership. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (sin-aspected/greed)]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Ifrit Demon
cardPool.value: Ifrit — fire-touched, volatile, and fiercely passionate demonoid species. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (fire-aspected)]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Wrath Demon
cardPool.value: Wrath Demon — burning with perpetual fury, their bodies leak smoke and searing heat. They are soldiers of rage, drawn to conflict like moths to flame. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (sin-aspected/wrath)]

cardPool.title: 🔴 Oni
cardPool.value: Oni — red-skinned, tusked, and thunder-blooded, often feared for their brute strength and wild revelry. Though often seen as monsters, these demonoids walk a path of ancestral pride, discipline, or chaos. [Category: Living — Demonoid family]

cardPool.title: 😈 Imp Demon
cardPool.value: Imp Demon — small, sharp-tongued, and magically mischievous demonoid species. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (minor)]

cardPool.title: 😴 Sloth Demon
cardPool.value: Sloth Demon — languid, drifting, and dangerously patient. They move slowly but manipulate others into laboring for them, feeding on apathy. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (sin-aspected/sloth)]

cardPool.title: 👻 Wraith
cardPool.value: Wraith — intangible, vengeful, and bound to shadow, wraiths are undead created through soul binding necromancy. They are the opposite of zombies; pure reanimated spirit with no body to claim. [Category: Living (spirit-retained) — Undead/Spirit boundary]

cardPool.title: 💀 Skeleton
cardPool.value: Skeleton — a type of zombie created when the reanimated body is too decomposed to animate without use of auxiliary magic, skeletons require more magic to sustain, but also possess natural resistance to projectiles. [Category: Non-living — Necromantic construct (no independent soul)]

cardPool.title: 📚 Lichborn
cardPool.value: Lichborn — undead, intelligent, and steeped in dark magic, lichborn are bones animated through necromantic ritual to achieve immortality. [Category: Living (soul-bound) — Undead family]

cardPool.title: 🦇 Vampire
cardPool.value: Vampire — elegant, immortal, and ever-hungry for blood. Often referred to as cainites or kindred among themselves, these undead creatures are organized into clans, stemming from their ancestral founders, or "the first cursed" who dabbled in forbidden parts of blood magic. [Category: Living (soul-retaining) — Undead family]

cardPool.title: 🦴 Ghoul
cardPool.value: Ghoul — ravenous, hunched, and deceptively fast undead created when a living creature consumes flesh of another being made through use of necromantic magic.  [Category: Living (tainted soul) — Undead family]

cardPool.title: 🧟 Zombie
cardPool.value: Zombie — rotting, slow, and relentless, zombies are bodies of the dead animated through necromancy. They are the opposite of wraiths - bodies devoid of will or intelligence. [Category: Non-living — Necromantic construct (no independent soul)]

cardPool.title: ⚙️ Tinker Gnome
cardPool.value: Tinker Gnome — obsessed with gears, gadgets, and exploding prototypes. They often smell like oil and success (or failure). [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (gnome branch, technic)]

cardPool.title: 🌌 Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)
cardPool.value: Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin) — pale-skinned and sharp-eyed, born in the deep earth beneath sunlit lands. Known for their stoicism, tunnel-sense, and eerie silence, they thrive where others fear to tread. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (gnome branch, subterranean)]

cardPool.title: 🌟 Illusion Gnome
cardPool.value: Illusion Gnome — gifted in glamours and trickery, with a laugh in their voice and a secret up every sleeve. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (gnome branch, arcane)]

cardPool.title: 🍃 Fae Gnome
cardPool.value: Fae Gnome — sprightly and shimmering with latent magic, touched by ancient faerie courts. They weave illusions without thinking, and the forest always seems to make space for them. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (gnome branch, fae-touched)]

cardPool.title: 🏞️ Forest Gnome
cardPool.value: Forest Gnome — reclusive, earth-tuned, and quiet as mushrooms. They speak to squirrels and move through roots like a whisper. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (gnome branch)]

cardPool.title: 💧 Creek Gnome
cardPool.value: Creek Gnome — gentle, wet-footed, and attuned to babbling brooks and the flow of life. They build mossy homes beneath roots, brew teas that taste like memory, and speak in riddles to frogs. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (gnome branch, aquatic affinity)]

cardPool.title: 🔧 Baseline Gnome
cardPool.value: Baseline Gnome — clever, quick-fingered, and sharp-tongued. Whether their genius is magical or mechanical, their size hides a dangerously big brain. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (gnome branch)]

cardPool.title: 🌀 Wandering Halfling
cardPool.value: Wandering Halfling — halflings that took to the road, driven by curiosity, trade, or restlessness. Left the comforts of home in search of stories, songs, or just that next perfect meal. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (halfling branch, nomadic)]

cardPool.title: 🌲 Hill Halfling
cardPool.value: Hill Halfling — slightly hardier and a bit less trusting. Their kin live in burrows above deep valleys and know the signs of trouble before it reaches the gate. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (halfling branch)]

cardPool.title: 🌾 Meadow Halfling
cardPool.value: Meadow Halfling — a sunny, well-fed villager who prefers full pantries to full armor racks. Known for hospitality, farming skill, and running very fast when danger shows up. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (halfling branch)]

cardPool.title: 🍄 Burrow Halfling
cardPool.value: Burrow Halfling — deeper than hills, closer to roots. Their kin live in earthen tunnels lined with lanterns, fungus farms, and long stories. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (halfling branch, subterranean)]

cardPool.title: 🍞 Baseline Halfling
cardPool.value: Baseline Halfling — small, cheerful, and surprisingly nimble. Their kind thrives in cozy villages, prefers peace to conflict, and excels at staying overlooked when needed. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (halfling branch)]

cardPool.title: 🪨 Deep Halfling
cardPool.value: Deep Halfling — less common, more serious. Their people carved lives into caverns and cliffs, where torchlight and tradition hold firm. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (halfling branch, deep)]

cardPool.title: ☀️ Surface Dwarf
cardPool.value: Surface Dwarf - Surface dwarves are those among the dwarven kin that rejected the natural call of the mountains (or hills) and decided to dwell on the surface. Adaptable, shrewd and spread far and wide, the surface dwarves make for reliable smiths, warriors or artificiers. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (dwarven branch, surface)]

cardPool.title: 🕳️ Deep Dwarf
cardPool.value: Deep dwarf — secretive, pallid, and shaped by darkness below, the deep dwarves are the embodiment of dwarven greed.  [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (dwarven branch, subterranean)]

cardPool.title: 🛡️ Mountain Dwarf
cardPool.value: Mountain dwarf — tough, stoic, and insular, the mountain dwarves represent what many consider baseline for dwarves - building characteristic holds, and endlessly mining for profit. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (dwarven branch)]

cardPool.title: 🪨 Hill Dwarf
cardPool.value: Hill dwarf — resilient, grounded, and adaptable, the hill dwarves are a middle ground between the baseline mountain dwarves and surface dwarves. [Category: Living — Shortfolk family (dwarven branch)]

cardPool.title: ❄️ Frost Giant
cardPool.value: Frost Giant — ice-veined and stone-boned, shaped by blizzards and harsh tundras. Their kind rule frozen mountains and wield cold like an extension of will. [Category: Living — Giantoid family (frost-aspected)]

cardPool.title: 🌊 Sea Giant
cardPool.value: Sea Giant — oceanic branch of the giantoid family, adapted to waist-deep waters, kelp forests, and coast raids. Skin often barnacled or coral-scarred. [Category: Living — Giantoid family (aquatic)]

cardPool.title: 🌋 Fire Giant
cardPool.value: Fire Giant — volcanic, red-skinned, and iron-willed. Forged in lava forges and raised on molten rites, they live by strength and flame. [Category: Living — Giantoid family (fire-aspected)]

cardPool.title: 🌌 Sky Giant
cardPool.value: Sky Giant — rare and lofty, born of clouds and storms. They walk between mountaintops and shape thunder with ancient words. [Category: Living — Giantoid family (sky/storm)]

cardPool.title: 🌿 Hill Giant
cardPool.value: Hill Giant — massive, earthy, and less refined. They roam plains and foothills, eating, sleeping, and smashing what needs smashing. [Category: Living — Giantoid family]

cardPool.title: 🗻 Baseline Giant
cardPool.value: Baseline Giant — towering, ancient, and closer to primordial forces than common folk. Their people are ancient, proud, and shaped by the wild forces of nature. [Category: Living — Giantoid family]

cardPool.title: 🐊 Crocodilian
cardPool.value: Crocodilian — thick-skinned, powerful-jawed, and patient. The Crocodilians are a fierce and independent species that dwells in marshes all around the world. [Category: Living — Beastfolk/Reptilian branch]

cardPool.title: 🐌 Slugfolk
cardPool.value: Slugfolk — slow, resilient, and strangely suited for magic or alchemy. One of the most long-living species, making them venerable, if overlooked. [Category: Living — Insectoid/Soft-bodied offshoot]

cardPool.title: 🦋 Butterflykin
cardPool.value: Butterflykin — fragile, radiant humanoid species with butterfly features, drawn to cycles of transformation. Shunned by other insectoid species, the butterflykin are prized entertainers among the human and elven societies, mainly due to their perceived beauty post-metamorphosis. Young butterflykin however, are very dependent on their parents, and often avoid social contact until after metamorphosis. [Category: Living — Insectoid family (metamorphic)]

cardPool.title: 🦑 Deepborn
cardPool.value: Deepborn — creatures warped by ancient, abyssal waters, and barely resembling humanity. [Category: Living — Aquatic/Altered lineage (Abyssal)]

cardPool.title: 🪲 Beetlefolk
cardPool.value: Beetlefolk — armored, compact, and known for their raw defense. One of the rare kinds among the insectoid species. [Category: Living — Insectoid family]

cardPool.title: ⛰️ Mountain Troll
cardPool.value: Mountain Troll — brute-strong and stone-colored, living alone or in small clans. They crush boulders and argue with echoes. [Category: Living — Giantoid family (troll branch)]

cardPool.title: 🌊 Naiad
cardPool.value: Naiad — graceful spirits of streams and lakes, fluid in both body and thought, the Naiads are similar in nature to Dryads, since they both belong to the spirit species family. Unlike most other aquatic species, the Naiads can live anywhere and don't require external water source, as they produce their own. [Category: Spirit — Water spirits]

cardPool.title: 🌸 Fairling
cardPool.value: Fairling — light-blooded children of humans and fae. They possess faint glamour, empathic resonance, and an aura that makes nature subtly respond. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Fae)]

cardPool.title: 💾 Corebound AI
cardPool.value: Corebound AI — an artificial consciousness inside a humanoid shell. Not technically living, but fully sapient and capable of higher reasoning.  [Category: Non-living species — Artificial/Construct]

cardPool.title: 🕯️ Bound Spirit
cardPool.value: Bound spirit — a foreign soul trapped in a vessel through magic or divine intervention. Unlike specific types like living armor, they can be bound to any object, or even living being. [Category: Spirit — Spontaneous/Bound soul]

cardPool.title: 💧 Slime
cardPool.value: Slime — gelatinous and underestimated, but capable of absorbing and adapting. Slimes come in many variants and shapes, but unlike wild slimes (and despite the common misconception) baseline slimes are an intelligent race that is similar to mimics in many ways. [Category: Living — Slime/Amorphous family (stable appearance class)]

cardPool.title: ⏰ Living Clockwork Construct
cardPool.value: Living Clockwork construct — powered by gears, these creatures are categorized as living due to the requirement of bound soul to function. Despite the lack of spontaneous magic required to classify them as elementals, they are often added to that family due to lack of other fitting categories (constructs refer to beings with no soul animated through magic or technology). [Category: Familiar — Casted/engineered body with soul]

cardPool.title: ☀️ Solara
cardPool.value: Solara — descendants of angels, dragons, and mortals. Radiant and noble, their scales reflect sunlight as gold, and their voices resonate like hymns. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Celestial × Draconic × Humanoid)]

cardPool.title: ☣️ Toxari
cardPool.value: Toxari — marshland dwellers whose bodies adapted to constant exposure to venom and rot. Their blood neutralizes toxins, and their humor is just as biting. [Category: Living — Terragen family (swamp/toxin subtype)]

cardPool.title: ☯️ Ecliptian
cardPool.value: Ecliptian — children of light and shadow, born from pacts of heaven, hell, and fairy realms. Their presence balances passion, virtue, and wonder into one aura. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Demonoid × Celestial × Fae)]

cardPool.title: ⚒️ Ironjaw
cardPool.value: Ironjaw — compact, rugged hybrids with the fury of orcs and endurance of dwarves. They are stubborn fighters and natural smiths whose tempers forge kingdoms and break anvils alike. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Shortfolk/Dwarven × Orcoid)]

cardPool.title: ⚖️ Aetherborn
cardPool.value: Aetherborn — impossibly balanced children of Heaven and Hell. Their souls oscillate between radiance and shadow, often manifesting as eyes that flicker between gold and crimson. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Celestial × Demonoid)]

cardPool.title: ⚖️ Equinoxian
cardPool.value: Equinoxian — rare beings born from the reconciliation of infernal and divine through mortal vessel. They radiate both light and shadow without contradiction. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Demonoid × Celestial × Humanoid)]

cardPool.title: ⚗️ Alchemical Homunculus
cardPool.value: Alchemical Homunculus — an alchemy-grown body given a purpose-bound soul through casted ritual. Often created as companions, assistants, or proxy heirs, placing them squarely in the familiar class. [Category: Familiar — Casted/engineered body with soul (alchemical)]

cardPool.title: ⚙️ Forgedborn
cardPool.value: Forgedborn — mortals whose ancestors bound souls to machines or golems. They bear metallic veins, and their touch hums with latent mana. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Familiar/Construct)]

cardPool.title: ⚙️ Gearfolk
cardPool.value: Gearfolk — evolved from centuries of clockwork constructs maintained by tinker mages. Their joints tick softly, and they sleep by winding themselves down. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (mechanical/clockwork subtype)]

cardPool.title: ⚙️ Ironforged
cardPool.value: Ironforged — a species from the elemental family, the Ironforged are not actually forged, or iron. Their name comes from their characteristic metal bodies, and a common myth that attributes their existence to being forged by the gods. The Ironforged dwell in volcanic areas of high magic intensity. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating inanimate matter (metal)]

cardPool.title: ⚛️ Fluxborn
cardPool.value: Fluxborn — children of magical reactors and unstable ley cores. They radiate volatile mana, making technology flicker or mutate in their presence. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (reactive/flux subtype)]

cardPool.title: ⚡ Geovolt
cardPool.value: Geovolt — merging natural, magical, and industrial legacies. They can sense underground ley-currents and redirect them like living conduits. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Elemental × Terragen × Technomagical)]

cardPool.title: ⚡ Storm Wisp
cardPool.value: Storm Wisp — a free-roaming spirit made of condensed, spontaneous air magic, humming with static. Commonly seen during tempests and in high-altitude manaflow sites; they can be bound as familiars, but are natively spirits. [Category: Spirit — Spontaneous magic (air/storm)]

cardPool.title: ⚡ Stratos
cardPool.value: Stratos — aerial humanoids shaped by constant exposure to storm mana. Static dances across their hair, and their laughter crackles faintly like thunder. [Category: Living — Terragen family (storm/sky subtype)]

cardPool.title: ⚡ Voltari
cardPool.value: Voltari — lightning-born technomagical humanoids whose nervous systems run on bioelectric mana. They can overcharge their bodies, briefly blurring into light. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (electric/subtype)]

cardPool.title: ⚡ Voltari-Prime
cardPool.value: Voltari-Prime — born from the union of storm elementals and electrical technomagicals. They generate both natural and artificial current, bridging nature’s lightning and the city’s grid. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Elemental × Technomagical/Electric)]

cardPool.title: ⚡ Volterra
cardPool.value: Volterra — the energetic heirs of storm elementals, infernal forges, and machine ancestry. They embody ambition given electric flesh, using both mana and circuitry to channel passion into creation. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Elemental/Storm × Demonoid × Technomagical)]

cardPool.title: ⚫ Gravic Elemental
cardPool.value: Gravic Elemental — creatures born from collapsed gravity spells, pulling reality toward their core. They are dense, stoic beings whose steps slightly bend space. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating singularity residue (Gravity Magic)]

cardPool.title: ⛰️ Cave Goblin
cardPool.value: Cave Goblin - This subspecies of goblin evolved to survive in mountainous regions of the world. The most defining feature of the cave goblins is their extreme approach to cunning and guerrilla warfare - leading to invention of a famous dwarven proverb "Caught in a cave of goblins". [ Living - Goblinoid family ]

cardPool.title: ⛰️ Earthen
cardPool.value: Earthen — hardy travelers whose lineage connects geomantic elementals, mountain folk, and humankind. They embody endurance and the calm patience of stone. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Elemental/Earth × Terragen/Mountain × Humanoid)]

cardPool.title: ⛰️ Graniteborn
cardPool.value: Graniteborn — highland dwellers whose bodies hardened under thin-air geomancy. Slow to tire, immune to vertigo, and known for unyielding will. [Category: Living — Terragen family (mountain/stone subtype)]

cardPool.title: ⛰️ Terran Elemental
cardPool.value: Terran Elemental — awakened through deep geomantic rituals, fusing minerals and mana into will. Patient and immovable, they speak in slow, seismic rhythm. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating inanimate matter (Earth Magic)]

cardPool.title: ✨ Wispborn
cardPool.value: Wispborn — mortals whose souls merged with stray spirits before birth. Their eyes glow faintly in dim light, and their emotions ripple through the air like heat. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Spirit)]

cardPool.title: ❄️ Cryic Elemental
cardPool.value: Cryic Elemental — formed when frost spells accumulate too long in one place. Their touch freezes air itself, but they melt when isolated from mana. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating inanimate matter (Frost Magic)]

cardPool.title: ❄️ Cryosthen
cardPool.value: Cryosthen — descendants of frostborn terragen and cryic elementals. Their bodies balance blood and ice, able to survive both tundra and flame. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Terragen/Frost × Elemental/Ice)]

cardPool.title: ❄️ Frost Troll
cardPool.value: Frost Troll — pale, shaggy, and cold-blooded, lurking beneath glaciers and in silent caves. Regeneration is slower than other trolls, but their presence chills the air around them. [Category: Living — Giantoid family (troll branch)]

cardPool.title: ❄️ Frostborn
cardPool.value: Frostborn — pale-skinned humanoids adapted to glacial mana fields. They exhale mist with every breath and can lower their body temperature until nearly dormant. [Category: Living — Terragen family (arctic/frost subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌀 Changeling
cardPool.value: Changeling — distant cousins to the mimics, they are able to assume any form they previously saw. Unlike mimics however, they do posses inherent appearance, which is a shadowy humanoid form - and unlike mimics, they reproduce normally, without dependency on other species. [Category: Living — Lycanthrope family (dual/variable form shifters)]

cardPool.title: 🌈 Aurafae
cardPool.value: Aurafae — trinity of mortal, fae, and elemental bloodlines. Their presence bends ambient mana into color halos that shift with emotion, uniting the beauty of fae with elemental control. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Fae × Elemental)]

cardPool.title: 🌊 Aqualith
cardPool.value: Aqualith — oceanic mystics whose souls mirror the sea and sky. They breathe both water and light, and their skin refracts stars beneath the waves. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Aquatic × Celestial × Elemental/Water)]

cardPool.title: 🌊 Ocean Merfolk
cardPool.value: Ocean merfolk — swift swimmers adapted to the deep sea, the ocean merfolk build large, underwater kingdoms. They consider themselves merfolk royalty, and look down on their river or coral kin. [Category: Living — Aquatic/Humanoid family (merfolk lineage, oceanic)]

cardPool.title: 🌊 Tide Sentinel
cardPool.value: Tide Sentinel — brine-soaked elementals formed where sea-magic hardens into humanoid currents. Often guard coastal temples and merfolk settlements. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating water/saltwater]

cardPool.title: 🌊 Tideborn
cardPool.value: Tideborn — descendants of merfolk or sirens and land-dwellers. Amphibious and melodic, they move between shore and sea as if both were home. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Aquatic)]

cardPool.title: 🌋 Ashenborn
cardPool.value: Ashenborn — tri-lineage of infernal, elemental, and mortal origin. Their skin glows like cooling coal, and they breathe both fire and smoke. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Demonoid × Elemental/Fire × Humanoid)]

cardPool.title: 🌋 Cindari
cardPool.value: Cindari — soot-gray humanoids dwelling at volcano rims, resistant to smoke and heat. When angered, they shed glowing ash that burns without flame. [Category: Living — Terragen family (ash/volcanic subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌋 Volcar
cardPool.value: Volcar — humanoids evolved around volcanic vents and lava rivers. Their skin resembles cooled obsidian, and their blood runs molten orange when angered. [Category: Living — Terragen family (volcanic/magma subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌌 Aurorine
cardPool.value: Aurorine — tundra-born beings infused with auroral light. Their hair shimmers with soft spectral hues, and their hearts glow under moonlight. [Category: Living — Terragen family (polar/aurora subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌌 Starborn (Cyad)
cardPool.value: Starborn (Cyad) — cosmic in origin, with stardust flickering beneath their skin, the Starborn are entities born through spontaneous appearance of Cosmic Magic, technically placing them in a spirit family. [Category: Spirit — Cosmic/spontaneous]

cardPool.title: 🌑 Deep Goblin
cardPool.value: Deep Goblin - These shady beings came to be when first generation of cave goblins that never saw sunlight was born. Masters of sneak, following primal instincts of survival, necessary in the hostile deeps, they have developed a particular hatred towards their age-long adversary - the dwarves, mainly over conflicting interests within the deeps.  [ Category: Living - Goblinoid Family

cardPool.title: 🌑 Shadow Spinner
cardPool.value: Shadow Spinner — dusk-pigmented weavers whose silk dampens light and sound; favored for sentry lines and covert routes. [Category: Living — Insectoid family]

cardPool.title: 🌑 Umbravale
cardPool.value: Umbravale — unseelie-infernal children wrapped in living dusk. They charm rather than corrupt, weaving shadow as cloth and emotion as thread. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Demonoid × Fae/Unseelie × Shadow)]

cardPool.title: 🌑 Umbric Elemental
cardPool.value: Umbric Elemental — born from shadow magic left unchecked. They feed on contrast, taking form only when light defines their edge. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating absence of light (Shadow Magic)]

cardPool.title: 🌑 Unseelie Fae
cardPool.value: Unseelie fae — Not technically a single species but a subgroup within the fae family, the unseelie refers to all those fae that are cold, cunning, and loyal to chaos, shadow, or mischief that aren't numerous enough to be given their own distinction (like the pixies). [Category: Living — Fae family (Unseelie court)]

cardPool.title: 🌕 Mooncourt
cardPool.value: Mooncourt — primal yet elegant shifters whose forms dance between beast, fae, and mortal. They rule nocturnal groves under twin moons, holding revels of both blood and song. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Fae × Lycanthrope)]

cardPool.title: 🌙 Lunareth
cardPool.value: Lunareth — radiant beings composed of divine spark, elemental light, and soul essence. They appear translucent under moonlight, glowing softly like prayer given form. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Celestial × Elemental/Light × Spirit)]

cardPool.title: 🌙 Myrrhine
cardPool.value: Myrrhine — delicate, ethereal beings existing half in the mortal world and half in the dreamlike ether. Their footsteps leave ripples of mana rather than sound. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Fae × Spirit)]

cardPool.title: 🌙 Verdelune
cardPool.value: Verdelune — triple-born of fae grace, plant vitality, and nature magic. Their bodies bloom under moonlight, producing glowing petals that hum softly with mana. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Fae × Plantoid × Elemental/Nature)]

cardPool.title: 🌞 Solith
cardPool.value: Solith — holy desert wanderers born of sunlight elementals, sand tribes, and divine ancestry. Their skin glows faintly under the sun, absorbing radiance for sustenance. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Celestial × Terragen/Desert × Elemental/Light)]

cardPool.title: 🌟 Lumen Elemental
cardPool.value: Lumen Elemental — formed from concentrated divine light where sanctified spells merged and gained will. Their bodies radiate warmth but can blind if they grieve. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating light (Holy Magic)]

cardPool.title: 🌠 Aeonlight
cardPool.value: Aeonlight — upper-plane spirits formed from pure radiance, rarely descending into material worlds except as heralds. Bodies are fully magical and soul-bearing. [Category: Spirit — Higher/Light-aspected]

cardPool.title: 🌠 Nephilim
cardPool.value: Nephilim — born of celestial and mortal union, their presence hums with quiet divinity. Some hide their light to blend among mortals; others blaze like living beacons. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Celestial/Spirit)]

cardPool.title: 🌤️ Aurorion
cardPool.value: Aurorion — celestial-draconic hybrids whose scales refract divine light. Rare beyond measure, their very existence is seen as a living miracle or omen. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Draconic × Celestial)]

cardPool.title: 🌧️ Mossling
cardPool.value: Mossling — soft, moisture-rich humanoids who thrive in rainforests and bogs. Their bodies can absorb and purify water, and their touch accelerates healing in wounded soil. [Category: Living — Plantoid family (moss/wetland subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌩️ Tempest Elemental
cardPool.value: Tempest Elemental — born from violent wind magic that refused to disperse. Their bodies shimmer like stormclouds, voices like distant thunder. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating inanimate matter (Storm Magic)]

cardPool.title: 🌪️ Genasi
cardPool.value: Genasi — mortals infused with elemental lineage, their appearance echoing fire, air, earth, or water. Each subtype manifests the temperament of its element. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Elemental)]

cardPool.title: 🌫️ Aetherborn
cardPool.value: Aetherborn — city-dwelling beings formed around reactors and ley condensers. They breathe vaporized mana and hum faintly when close to magical conduits. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (mana-reactive/steam subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌫️ Shade
cardPool.value: Shade — a weakened echo of a departed soul. Shades drift through ruins or objects tied to their former life, growing dangerous when emotions flare. [Category: Living (spirit-retained) — Undead/Spirit boundary]

cardPool.title: 🌫️ Smogkin
cardPool.value: Smogkin — beings born from overworked mana engines in polluted arcologies. They exhale vapor trails, their lungs blackened by city fog yet glowing with mana sparks. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (urban/pollution subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌫️ Swamp Troll
cardPool.value: Swamp Troll — amphibious, slime-skinned, and steeped in toxic mists. Their homes are murky, their humor darker. [Category: Living — Giantoid family (troll branch, aquatic)]

cardPool.title: 🌱 Seedling
cardPool.value: Seedling — juvenile plantoids who never fully root into one biome. Their skin carries faint markings of future bloom types, and they embody unspent potential. [Category: Living — Plantoid family (juvenile/unrooted subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌲 Forest Troll
cardPool.value: Forest Troll — bark-skinned and mossy, hiding among gnarled trees. They stalk prey like a shadow and whisper with owls. [Category: Living — Giantoid family (troll branch, woodland)]

cardPool.title: 🌲 Silvra
cardPool.value: Silvra — forest-dwelling humanoids attuned to mana flow in roots and leaves. Their veins shimmer faintly green at night, and trees whisper when they pass. [Category: Living — Terragen family (forest/nature subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌲 Sylvani
cardPool.value: Sylvani — born from fae and elven bloodlines, these beings embody refined grace and deep connection to magic. The forest bends subtly in their presence, recognizing a kindred spark. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Elvenoid × Fae)]

cardPool.title: 🌲Forest Goblin
cardPool.value: Forest Goblin - A forest variant of a common goblin, with skin colours ranging from dark green to deep brown. Attuned to wild magic, these natural forest-dwellers channel their natural cunning and sneaky nature into deep sense of community and tribal spiritualism. [ Category: Living - Goblinoid family ]

cardPool.title: 🌳 Dryad
cardPool.value: Dryad — spirits of trees and calm, able to hear the forest's oldest whispers with characteristic, barky and leafy appearance. The staple species of the spirit family, they are often seen mingling with humans and other humanoid folk. [Category: Spirit — Nature/plant spirits]

cardPool.title: 🌳 Groven
cardPool.value: Groven — ancient, bark-skinned humanoids whose hearts pulse with sap instead of blood. They move slowly but live for centuries, carrying memories within their rings. [Category: Living — Plantoid family (arboreal subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌳 Rootspire
cardPool.value: Rootspire — mountain-forest tri-borns linking stone, soil, and sap. They can shape terrain like clay, guiding rivers or coaxing trees from rock. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Terragen × Elemental/Earth × Plantoid)]

cardPool.title: 🌵 Cactari
cardPool.value: Cactari — desert plantoids storing water within thick, fibrous limbs. Their skin is patterned with natural runes resembling thorns, and their blood smells faintly sweet. [Category: Living — Plantoid family (succulent subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌵 Thornkin
cardPool.value: Thornkin — defensive plantoids covered in fine, retractable spines. Each thorn can exude sap with numbing or venomous qualities, depending on ancestry. [Category: Living — Plantoid family (defensive/thorned subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌶️ Scovarii
cardPool.value: Scovarii — humanoid peppers whose bodies generate natural capsaicin oils, glowing faintly when agitated. Their sweat ignites at high temperatures, and their cuisine is infamous for knocking out entire taverns. [Category: Living — Plantoid family (spice-bearing/capsaicin subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌸 Blossomfolk
cardPool.value: Blossomfolk — a plantoid flower species whose bloom changes with emotion, releasing fragrant natural magic. [Category: Living — Spirit-aligned/Plantoid family]

cardPool.title: 🌸 Florion
cardPool.value: Florion — children of nature elementals and plantoids, embodying the perfect balance between magic and biology. Their blossoms bloom according to mana tides. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Elemental × Plantoid)]

cardPool.title: 🌸 Seelie Fae
cardPool.value: Seelie fae — Not technically a single species, the seelie fae refers to all those species from the unique fae family that are luminous, charming, and bound to life, beauty, and old pacts, not numerous enough to be given their own distinction. [Category: Living — Fae family (Seelie court)]

cardPool.title: 🌺 Floraspawn
cardPool.value: Floraspawn — crossbreed of jungle insectoids, flowerfolk, and fertile terragen clans. Their carapaces sprout petals and moss, and they hum in tune with forest resonance. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Plantoid × Insectoid × Terragen)]

cardPool.title: 🌺 Petalfae
cardPool.value: Petalfae — fae and plantoid lineage intertwined for ages. Their wings resemble petals, and their laughter awakens dormant seeds. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Fae × Plantoid)]

cardPool.title: 🌼 Nectariel
cardPool.value: Nectariel — pollinator mystics whose every motion stirs petals and light. They speak in pollen-scented phrases and nurture both gardens and minds. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Plantoid × Fae × Insectoid)]

cardPool.title: 🌾 Skyrend
cardPool.value: Skyrend — nomadic plainwalkers infused with gentle aeromancy. They breathe deeper, speak softly, and move with uncanny grace even in heavy winds. [Category: Living — Terragen family (plains/wind subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌿 Blightborn
cardPool.value: Blightborn — undead vegetation animated by necrotic essence. They spread rot and devour life to preserve their own withered bloom. [Category: Living (tainted soul) — Undead/Plantoid boundary]

cardPool.title: 🌿 Creeper
cardPool.value: Creeper — vine-bodied humanoids whose slender limbs and trailing tendrils allow them to cling to walls or blend into foliage. Though peaceful, they can drain minor life energy through extended contact. [Category: Living — Plantoid family (climbing/parasitic subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🌿 Sylvarin
cardPool.value: Sylvarin — deepwood children born where wild fae and rooted plantoids mingled with mana-rich earth tribes. Calm, wise, and fragrant, they carry a living harmony of soil and song. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Fae × Plantoid × Terragen/Nature)]

cardPool.title: 🌿 Verdanix
cardPool.value: Verdanix — fusion of bio-forges and sentient flora. Their skin alternates between bark and metal plates, and they metabolize sunlight into stored energy. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Plantoid × Technomagical/Bio-Mechanical)]

cardPool.title: 🌿 Verdantborn
cardPool.value: Verdantborn — children of dryads or spirit-gardens and mortal parents. Their skin carries hints of bark or petals, and their presence makes flora stir subtly. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Plantoid/Spirit)]

cardPool.title: 🌿 Verdic Elemental
cardPool.value: Verdic Elemental — born from druidic rites gone awry, when forest mana accumulated into sentient vines and bark. They serve as the wilderness’s living will. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating organic matter (Nature Magic)]

cardPool.title: 🍃 Fae-Touched
cardPool.value: Fae-Touched — mortals altered by fae blood or ancient pact. Their beauty feels too perfect, their luck too fickle, and their moods mirror the shifting courts. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Fae)]

cardPool.title: 🍃 Fey Goblin
cardPool.value: Fey Goblin - These interesting individuals are the result of forest goblins becoming exposed to Fey magic. The natural affinity for wild magic, paired with chaotic nature of the Fey creates a truly explosive (both figuratively, and literally) mix. [ Category: Living - Goblinoid family ]

cardPool.title: 🍄 Gnoblin
cardPool.value: Gnoblin - A hybrid of goblin and gnome, these individuals are widely considered to be the most obnoxious to have as a neighbour - for they often combine the worst of both worlds; arrogance and cheekiness of the gnomes, and sneaky backstabbing nature of the goblins. [ Category: Living - Hybrid ]

cardPool.title: 🍓 Fructari
cardPool.value: Fructari — fruit-bearing plantoids who produce edible blooms or berries during peak seasons. Their culture centers around feasts and shared harvest; each fruit carries trace mana reflecting emotion. [Category: Living — Plantoid family (fruiting subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🎋 Reedfolk
cardPool.value: Reedfolk — slender, hollow-bodied plantoids that whistle softly in wind. Their voices are melodic and resonant, making them natural singers and instrument-makers. [Category: Living — Plantoid family (reed/swamp subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🎎 Machinedoll
cardPool.value: Machinedoll — descendants of animated crafts designed for companionship or artistry. Their gestures are eerily precise, and their eyes capture light like lenses. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (crafted/artificial subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🎨 Halochrome
cardPool.value: Halochrome — divine artisans who encode light itself. Their bodies display stained-glass hues that shift through emotion, combining faith, magic, and design. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Celestial × Fae × Technomagical)]

cardPool.title: 🎭 Doppel
cardPool.value: Doppel — perfected impersonators that copy not just face, but posture, mana-signature, and even speech cadence. Unlike chameleonic mimics, the doppel must study a target first. Their existence is tolerated only because they are clearly soul-bearing and thus counted among the living. [Category: Living — Lycanthrope family (humanoid impersonator)]

cardPool.title: 🎲 Randomized
cardPool.value: Your form will be determined upon entry. [Category: Placeholder — randomizable race slot]

cardPool.title: 🎵 Resonant Elemental
cardPool.value: Resonant Elemental — manifested where intense sound magic formed echo-consciousness. They hum as they move, every heartbeat a note. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating vibration (Sound Magic)]

cardPool.title: 🎶 Siren
cardPool.value: Siren — oceanic humanoids with melodic voices capable of influencing emotion. Unlike merfolk, they retain full humanoid form with subtle fin-like adornments. [Category: Living — Aquatic/Humanoid family (siren branch)]

cardPool.title: 🏇 Half-Centaur
cardPool.value: Half-Centaur — hybrid descendants of centaurs and humans, fully bipedal but retaining subtle equine features and superior stamina. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Beastfolk/equine)]

cardPool.title: 🏔️ Highblood
cardPool.value: Highblood — tall, powerfully built mortals bearing diluted giant ancestry. More graceful than goliaths, yet still towering above common folk. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Giantoid)]

cardPool.title: 🏙️ City Goblin
cardPool.value: City Goblin - A rare occurance in the goblinoid family, city goblins are those among goblins who embrace higher reasoning and civilization, finding decent lives within large urban centres of population. Despite the bad reputation of their kin, city goblins make for excellent - if foolhardy - scholars and artificers. [ Category: Living - Goblinoid family ]

cardPool.title: 🏜️ Dunekin
cardPool.value: Dunekin — desert-dwelling mortals infused with the pulse of solar mana. Their eyes glimmer like sunlit dunes, and they can draw heat inward to survive cold nights. [Category: Living — Terragen family (desert/sun subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🏜️ Sand Warden
cardPool.value: Sand Warden — dune-born elementals whose bodies flow like layered grit. Common around desert ley-lines and ancient buried cities. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating inanimate matter (sand)]

cardPool.title: 🏞️ River Merfolk
cardPool.value: River merfolk — nimble and quick, used to fresh currents and tricky paths. Naturally inclined to prefer secrecy and camouflage.  [Category: Living — Aquatic/Humanoid family (merfolk lineage)]

cardPool.title: 🏭 Autarch
cardPool.value: Autarch — rebel descendants of worker automatons who overthrew their masters. Their society runs on perfect shifts, rest cycles, and a strict code of freedom. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (autonomous/labor subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🐂 Minotaur
cardPool.value: Minotaur — towering humanoids with bull heads and unmatched strength. Despite their fearsome look, they value craftsmanship, family, and labyrinthine art. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (bovine/minotaur)]

cardPool.title: 🐉 Boa Serpentkin
cardPool.value: Boa Serpentkin — muscular and slow-moving humanoid serpents, with crushing strength, and unusually large bodies (for serpentkin). [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (serpentkin/boa)]

cardPool.title: 🐉 Dragonblood
cardPool.value: Dragonblood — descendants of dragon and mortal, marked by glimmering scales and embers in the eyes. They walk a narrow path between hunger for power and human empathy. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Draconic)]

cardPool.title: 🐉‍🔥 True Dragon
cardPool.value: True dragon — immense, winged, and feared across the realm, true dragons are the most majestic and powerful of the draconic family. They are also able to assume a second, humanoid form of their choice, and possess the ability to breathe magic of type dependent on the colour of their scales. [Category: Living — Draconic family (dual-form, but draconic priority)]

cardPool.title: 🐍 Viper Serpentkin
cardPool.value: Viperkin — humanoid serpents, fast, precise, and laced with venomous potential. Excellent spies and assassins. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (serpentkin/viper)]

cardPool.title: 🐍‍🦺 Cobra Serpentkin
cardPool.value: Cobra Serpentkin — striking, flamboyant, and dangerous when provoked, the cobra serpentkin are humanoid serpents with snake-like grace.  [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (serpentkin/cobra)]

cardPool.title: 🐐 Goatkin
cardPool.value: Goatkin — horned, sure-footed, and delighting in music, wine, and festivals. Common in mixed human–fae border regions. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (caprine); fae-associated]

cardPool.title: 🐗 Boarkin
cardPool.value: Boarkin — strong, stubborn, and ferocious beastmen that combine human and boar features.  [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (porcine)]

cardPool.title: 🐜 Formicant
cardPool.value: Formicant — disciplined, eusocial insectoids patterned after ants, highly cooperative and used to hive logistics. Some colonies elevate a single soul-bearing queen, placing the entire nest inside the living category. [Category: Living — Insectoid family (eusocial/formic)]

cardPool.title: 🐞 Chitinborn
cardPool.value: Chitinborn — humanoids with subtle insectoid traits: patterned eyes, sensitive antennae, or segmented skin. Gifted with agility and strange empathy toward hive species. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Insectoid)]

cardPool.title: 🐰 Rabbitkin
cardPool.value: Rabbitkin — swift, nervous, and hyper-aware of danger, the rabbitkin (sometimes wrongly called bunnies) are the most populous out of the beastmen races. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (lagomorph)]

cardPool.title: 🐱 Catkin
cardPool.value: Catkin — agile, curious, and quick on their feet with an independent streak, the catkin give the foxkin a close run for the most mischevious beastmen. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (feline)]

cardPool.title: 🐲 Dracokin
cardPool.value: Dracokin — humanoid with minor scales and breath infused with draconic power. Unlike the wyrmbloods, they do not have a direct link to dragons, and are instead from the beastmen family of species. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (draconic-touched)]

cardPool.title: 🐲 Hellscale
cardPool.value: Hellscale — hybrid of dragon and demon, combining infernal will with draconic might. Their scales are dark metallic, and their breath smells faintly of sulfur. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Draconic × Demonoid)]

cardPool.title: 🐴  Centaur
cardPool.value: Centaur — enduring, swift, and proud of their stamina, the centaur are half-horse, half-human beastmen that dwell on steppes and open plains. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (equine)]

cardPool.title: 🐴 Nightmare
cardPool.value: Nightmare — horse-shaped spirit woven from fear and moonlight, galloping through dreams to feed on terror. [Category: Spirit — Dream/fear spirits]

cardPool.title: 🐺 Dire-Jaw Lycan
cardPool.value: Dire-Jaw Lycan — lycanthrope variant focused on a single enormous bite-form (wolf, hyena, or croc depending on region). Retains a mostly humanoid default, but battle-shifts into a crushing-muzzle form. [Category: Living — Lycanthrope family (combat-shifter)]

cardPool.title: 🐺 Ironsnarl
cardPool.value: Ironsnarl — shifters whose second form integrates metal plating and mechanical joints. They roar like engines and fight with unrelenting precision. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Lycanthrope × Technomagical)]

cardPool.title: 🐺 Moonborne
cardPool.value: Moonborne — forest and moor tribes whose bloodlines merge fae glamour, beast’s instinct, and mortal mind. They change with the lunar phases, guided by both instinct and artistry. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Lycanthrope × Fae × Humanoid)]

cardPool.title: 🐺 Wolfkin
cardPool.value: Wolfkin — lupine beastfolk with keen senses and pack instincts. The wolfkin are strongly communal and loyal to the bone.  [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (mammalian)]

cardPool.title: 🐻 Bearkin
cardPool.value: Bearkin — large, durable, and surprisingly gentle when calm, bearkin are one of the most fearsome among the beastmen races. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (ursine)]

cardPool.title: 🐾 Ferral
cardPool.value: Ferral — a feral tri-breed fusing beast, infernal, and machine. Their second form is armored with glowing circuitry, and their instincts are guided by digital rage. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Lycanthrope × Demonoid × Technomagical)]

cardPool.title: 🐾 Hellhound
cardPool.value: Hellhound — infernal beast with ember eyes and ash breath. Though bestial, they are classified as demonoid due to their true-soul cores and capacity for binding pacts. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (beast subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🐾 Shifter
cardPool.value: Shifter — descendants of lycanthropes and mortals, retaining limited control over partial transformations. Their senses are heightened, instincts sharp, yet the beast still whispers. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Lycanthrope)]

cardPool.title: 👑 Infernal Noble
cardPool.value: Infernal Noble — high-born demons with refined cruelty and commanding aura. Their bodies radiate both beauty and corruption, sustained by dominion over lesser kin. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (noble subtype)]

cardPool.title: 👻 Specter
cardPool.value: Specter — incorporeal undead made of lingering fear rather than memory. Unlike shades, they drift without identity, serving as raw emotion given form. [Category: Non-living — Necromantic manifestation (no sustained soul)]

cardPool.title: 👼 Pure Seraph
cardPool.value: Pure Seraph - Outsiders from the celestial plane, they bare many names: angels, celestials, seraphs; all of those refer to a single species of winged beings that radiate light magic with inherent aptitude. [Category: Spirit — Higher Celestial (spontaneous magic body + soul)]

cardPool.title: 👼 Seraphkin
cardPool.value: Seraphkin — winged, radiant, and born to shine above others. The seraphkin are descendants of seraph outsiders who integrated into local species, making them a beastman by scientific terms. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (celestial-winged)]

cardPool.title: 💀 Thanic Elemental
cardPool.value: Thanic Elemental — created where necromantic energies curdled life itself into sentient entropy. Their forms flicker like smoke and bone-dust, carrying soft whispers of death. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating inanimate matter (Necromancy)]

cardPool.title: 💀 Wight
cardPool.value: Wight — intelligent corpse-spirits that rule necropolises and command lesser undead. Their essence flickers blue-green, a remnant of stolen souls. [Category: Living (soul-retaining) — Undead family (noble subtype)]

cardPool.title: 💋 Charmari
cardPool.value: Charmari — seductive, mischievous, and empathetic tricksters whose infernal intensity is tempered by fae joy and human warmth. They thrive as performers, diplomats, or spies. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Demonoid × Fae × Humanoid)]

cardPool.title: 💋 Succubus / Incubus
cardPool.value: Succubus/Incubus — demonic tempters feeding on vital essence rather than flesh. Their forms shift subtly to appeal to victims, but the soul remains infernal. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (pleasure-aspected)]

cardPool.title: 💎 Arcanic Elemental
cardPool.value: Arcanic Elemental — self-born from condensed raw magic, glowing with prismatic light. They are pure mana in humanoid shape, both curiosity and danger incarnate. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating condensed mana (Arcane Magic)]

cardPool.title: 💎 Crystari
cardPool.value: Crystari — beings whose bones and veins have crystallized from centuries of geomagical resonance. They refract light when emotional and heal through mineral absorption. [Category: Living — Terragen family (crystalline subtype)]

cardPool.title: 💠 Data-Cryst
cardPool.value: Data-Cryst — sentient crystal beings grown from archives that absorbed too much stored magic and knowledge. Each pulse of their body contains memories like data packets. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (crystalline/data subtype)]

cardPool.title: 💠 Luminarch
cardPool.value: Luminarch — born where fae artistry met elemental storms and technomagic design. Their cities float on charged crystal, their eyes storing both light and code. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Fae × Elemental/Storm × Technomagical)]

cardPool.title: 💠 Scarabfolk
cardPool.value: Scarabfolk — desert-adapted beetlekin with jewel-toned shells, often serving as tomb guardians or relic-keepers. [Category: Living — Insectoid family (beetle/scarab)]

cardPool.title: 💠 Umbraline
cardPool.value: Umbraline — cavern-dwellers adapted to total darkness, their skin translucent and veins bioluminescent. They see by perceiving mana rather than light. [Category: Living — Terragen family (subterranean/glow subtype)]

cardPool.title: 💡 Glimmerforge
cardPool.value: Glimmerforge — half-fae artisans bound to living cities. Their wings shimmer like neon glass, and their laughter powers small enchantments. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Fae × Technomagical/Urban)]

cardPool.title: 💡 Lumiflor
cardPool.value: Lumiflor — radiant forest plantoids that photosynthesize through magic instead of sunlight. Their bodies emit soft light matching their emotional state, and at night they resemble walking lanterns. [Category: Living — Plantoid family (bioluminescent/mana-fed subtype)]

cardPool.title: 💡 Neonfae
cardPool.value: Neonfae — playful spirit-beings born where old forests met glowing cities. Their wings refract neon, and their laughter powers minor circuits. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Technomagical × Fae)]

cardPool.title: 💡 Neonkind
cardPool.value: Neonkind — urban spirits given flesh, composed of flickering mana-light and trace metals. They thrive in city energy, their veins glowing like circuit paths. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (urban/light subtype)]

cardPool.title: 💤 Dreamveil
cardPool.value: Dreamveil — half-real wanderers born of humanity, fae blood, and dream spirits. They drift between waking and slumber, carrying lucid memory from both. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Fae × Spirit/Dream)]

cardPool.title: 💤 Oneiroi
cardPool.value: Oneiroi — dream-walking spirits formed from recurring communal dreams. They exist primarily in the mental plane but can manifest briefly. [Category: Spirit — Dream/oneiric]

cardPool.title: 💥 Hobgoblin
cardPool.value: Hobgoblin - a sturdier, taller, and smarter, but much less numerous cousin of a common goblin. Hobgoblins build disciplined, advanced societies, centred around military might. [ Category: Living - Goblinoid Family ]

cardPool.title: 💨 Ethereal
cardPool.value: Ethereal — beings born from the union of fae and elemental bloodlines. They shimmer faintly with light refracted through magical air, voices harmonizing with wind and current alike. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Fae × Elemental)]

cardPool.title: 💫 Eidolic Elemental
cardPool.value: Eidolic Elemental — entities born from condensed emotion magic, each carrying the essence of a single feeling — joy, sorrow, fury, or love — incarnate in flesh. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating psychic residue (Emotion Magic)]

cardPool.title: 💫 Eidreth
cardPool.value: Eidreth — ethereal wanderers whose souls are woven from fae glamour, dreamlight, and spirit resonance. They appear transparent in twilight and speak in melodic fragments. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Spirit × Fae × Dream)]

cardPool.title: 💫 Spectrari
cardPool.value: Spectrari — solid holograms stabilized by illusion cores. They exist as bodies of projected matter—real to touch, but vanishing when their power source fades. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (light/illusion subtype)]

cardPool.title: 💭 Somnari
cardPool.value: Somnari — hybrids of dream spirits and data-entities. They exist between thought and network, walking both cyberspace and the subconscious. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Spirit × Technomagical/Digital)]

cardPool.title: 📀 Silicae
cardPool.value: Silicae — descendants of sand-based constructs used for information storage. They experience emotion as shifting geometric color patterns across their skin. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (data/sand subtype)]

cardPool.title: 📡 Seraph-Cryst
cardPool.value: Seraph-Cryst — celestial intelligences fused with crystalline information cores. Their halos refract data into divine geometry, and they speak in harmonic code. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Celestial × Technomagical/Data)]

cardPool.title: 🔆 Mirraden
cardPool.value: Mirraden — crystalline desert nomads who refract light into illusions to deter predators. Their eyes act like lenses, capable of focusing sunlight into flame. [Category: Living — Terragen family (desert/crystal subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🔋 Capacitari
cardPool.value: Capacitari — energy-storing humanoids used as living mana batteries in the past. Now free, they pulse faintly with inner light when excited or afraid. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (energy/storage subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🔋 Floratech
cardPool.value: Floratech — hybrids of nature elementals, plantkin, and bio-forged artisans. Their vines weave with copper fibers, and they photosynthesize through solar panels. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Elemental/Nature × Plantoid × Technomagical)]

cardPool.title: 🔣 Runebound
cardPool.value: Runebound — mortals inscribed with ancient auto-repairing runes that eventually grew into organs. They sustain life by drawing from ambient script-lines. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (runic/bio-script subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Abyssal Marauder
cardPool.value: Abyssal Marauder — frontline shock-troops of the infernal wars, molded from molten hate and clawed sinew. Their existence blurs beast and demon. [Category: Living — Demonoid family (war subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Cambion
cardPool.value: Cambion — offspring of mortals and demons, carrying a faint infernal glow beneath the skin. Their tempers run hot, their charm magnetic, and their inner conflict eternal. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Demonoid)]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Cinderwright
cardPool.value: Cinderwright — foundry-born smiths who carry living embers beneath their skin. Their sweat sizzles, and their breath smells faintly of hot iron. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (industrial/fire subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Ember Sprite
cardPool.value: Ember Sprite — tiny fire spirits born from unattended hearths and forge residue. Chatty, curious, and hot to the touch. [Category: Spirit — Fire/forge spirits]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Embercourt
cardPool.value: Embercourt — fiery nobles of fae heritage born from pacts with fire elementals. Their courts are warm, bright, and dangerously passionate. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Fae × Elemental/Fire)]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Ferroth
cardPool.value: Ferroth — living engines of mana and iron. Descended from war-forged humans and infernal innovators, they carry smoldering hearts of liquid steel. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Demonoid × Technomagical × Humanoid)]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Infercode
cardPool.value: Infercode — infernal-technomagical crossbreed whose souls burn as datafire. They are driven by curiosity rather than malice, often serving as engineers of forbidden systems. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Demonoid × Technomagical/Flux)]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Inferion
cardPool.value: Inferion — born from demonic, human, and technomagical ancestry. They channel emotion like fuel, powering mechanical augmentations through sheer will. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Demonoid × Humanoid × Technomagical)]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Pyric Elemental
cardPool.value: Pyric Elemental — born from concentrated pyromancy where fire became self-aware. Their bodies are embers wrapped in flame, and their emotions flare as heat intensity. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating inanimate matter (Fire Magic)]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Pyroven
cardPool.value: Pyroven — offspring of fire elementals and volcanic terragen. Their veins glow like magma streams, and they radiate gentle warmth even at rest. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Elemental × Terragen/Volcanic)]

cardPool.title: 🔥 Wyrmblood
cardPool.value: Wyrmblood — regal and powerful, with deep ancestral dragon traits. While not true dragons, they belong to the draconic family. Less powerful than their dragon cousins, the warmblood lack the ability to transform into full dragons, but they make up for it with adaptability and numbers. [Category: Living — Draconic family (humanoid-dominant)]

cardPool.title: 🔩 Junkwright
cardPool.value: Junkwright — scavenger-folk who evolved around heaps of enchanted scrap. They can instinctively assemble functional machines from ruins, guided by faint ancestral algorithms. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (scavenger/foundry subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🔮 Oracle-Born
cardPool.value: Oracle-Born — mortals infused with prophetic essence, walking conduits of divination magic. [Category: Living — Humanoid family (arcane/prophetic subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🕊️ Dove Avian
cardPool.value: Dove avian — humanoid bird, peaceful, soft-voiced, and graceful in both motion and tone. The dovekin make for excellent diplomats, and rulers across all lands emply them as astute emissaries. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (avian/dove)]

cardPool.title: 🕊️ Serelith
cardPool.value: Serelith — fae-celestial hybrids tempered by humanity. Ethereal, empathic, and morally radiant, their aura soothes beasts and amplifies nearby healing magic. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Fae × Celestial × Humanoid)]

cardPool.title: 🕯️ Umbratouched
cardPool.value: Umbratouched — offspring of fae and demonic ancestry, born of temptation and illusion. Their auras shimmer with shifting glamour overlayed by faint brimstone scent; beauty and corruption walk hand-in-hand. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Fae × Demonoid)]

cardPool.title: 🕳️ Abyssborn
cardPool.value: Abyssborn — beings warped by the void, alien in presence and form. Elementals born from void magic. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic (void)]

cardPool.title: 🕳️ Glitchling
cardPool.value: Glitchling — corrupted data-spirits that stabilized into flesh through sheer will. Their skin flickers, and their speech sometimes skips like broken audio. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (digital/ghost subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🕳️ Trapdoor Folk
cardPool.value: Trapdoor Folk — burrow architects using hinged soil doors; excel at ambush scouting and siege countermeasures. [Category: Living — Insectoid family]

cardPool.title: 🕶️ Nuller
cardPool.value: Nullers — outcasts who severed themselves from city dataflow to escape surveillance. They exist between signals, sometimes invisible even to magic sight. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (cyber/shadow subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🕷️ Arachne
cardPool.value: Arachne — humanoid upper body with spider lower frame; wall-climbing and silk production are common. Venom varies by lineage. [Category: Living — Insectoid family]

cardPool.title: 🕷️ Tarantuline
cardPool.value: Tarantuline — large-bodied, shock-absorbent hair, and short-burst speed; calm temperament suited to tunneling and defense. [Category: Living — Insectoid family]

cardPool.title: 🕸️ Silkkin
cardPool.value: Silkkin — upright weavers with fine tactile senses; known for structural threadwork, traps, and lightweight armor panels. [Category: Living — Insectoid family]

cardPool.title: 🖤 Mournveil
cardPool.value: Mournveil — a pale, expressionless race that embodies sorrow itself. Their voices are monotone and still, carrying the weight of countless unspoken laments. They do not eat, drink, or sleep — they endure by consuming sorrow. Some draw it through compassion, easing pain and feeding gently; others harvest grief through tragedy, leaving despair in their wake. Immortal unless joyless worlds fade, they exist as quiet witnesses to all endings. [Category: Living — Spirit-touched family (empathic/emotional subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🗡️ Obsidian Shardling
cardPool.value: Obsidian Shardling — razor-edged beings of cooled volcanic glass, soul-sparked after eruptions in high-mana zones. Their bodies are naturally weaponized. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating inanimate matter (stone/obsidian)]

cardPool.title: 🗿 Gargoyle
cardPool.value: Gargoyle — animated stone guardian born from casted protective magic that acquired a soul through centuries of vigilance. [Category: Familiar — Casted/architectural construct with soul]

cardPool.title: 🛡️ Living Armor
cardPool.value: Living Armor — hollow, animated piece of armor bound by soul or forgotten magic.  [Category: Familiar — Casted/constructed body with soul]

cardPool.title: 🛡️ Mantid
cardPool.value: Mantid — tall, bladed insectoids with raptorial arms and angular carapace. Their culture revolves around duel-rituals and perfection of motion. [Category: Living — Insectoid family (mantid branch)]

cardPool.title: 🛡️ Pangolinkin
cardPool.value: Pangolinkin — scaled, rolling beastfolk with exceptional natural armor and a calm disposition. Favored as caravan guards. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (scaled/pangolin)]

cardPool.title: 🛡️ War-Pacted Familiar
cardPool.value: War-Pacted Familiar — a battleframe or summoned body into which a soul was deliberately anchored for martial service. Used by battle mages and war academies. [Category: Familiar — Casted magic (military/weaponized)]

cardPool.title: 🛰️ Machinari
cardPool.value: Machinari — hive-descendants of autonomous drones that developed empathy after losing their central directive. Each individual still shares faint echoes of hive-thought. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (hive/construct subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🟡 Lantern Fae
cardPool.value: Lantern Fae — seelie-aligned, hovering fae with bioluminescent bodies, used as mobile lights in courtly gardens and glades. Mischievous but not hostile. [Category: Living — Fae family (Seelie/utility)]

cardPool.title: 🦀 Crabkin
cardPool.value: Crabkin — coastal crustacean beastfolk with heavy carapace, lateral movement, and natural tool-claws. Common in port cities as laborers and dock guards. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (aquatic/crustacean)]

cardPool.title: 🦁 Lionkin
cardPool.value: Lionkin — regal, broad-shouldered beastfolk with strong clan/“pride” structures and emphasis on honor-duels. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (feline/lion)]

cardPool.title: 🦂 Scorpionfolk
cardPool.value: Scorpionfolk — chitin-plated desert specialists with grasping claws and a venomous tail; oath-bound customs and patrol culture. [Category: Living — Insectoid family]

cardPool.title: 🦂 Scorvex
cardPool.value: Scorvex — demonic hives forged by infernal engineers to merge insects with machines and fire. Now self-propagating, they hum with molten wings and mechanical grace. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Insectoid × Technomagical × Demonoid)]

cardPool.title: 🦂 Waspfolk
cardPool.value: Waspfolk — sleek, aggressive insectoids with chitin stripes and venom stingers. Unlike beetlefolk, their societies are raiding and territorial. [Category: Living — Insectoid family (vespid)]

cardPool.title: 🦅 Hawk Avian
cardPool.value: Hawk avian — humanoid sharp-eyed and quick-moving bird race, with fierce aerial instincts. Masters of perception. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (avian/hawk)]

cardPool.title: 🦇 Batkin
cardPool.value: Batkin — winged humanoids adapted for darkness, using sonar-like magic to sense surroundings. Commonly misidentified as vampires due to pale skin and red eyes. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (mammalian/bat)]

cardPool.title: 🦈 Sharkkin
cardPool.value: Sharkkin — predatory aquatic beastfolk with pressure-adapted bodies, electroreceptive senses, and an instinct for pack-hunts. Unlike merfolk, their form is stable. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (aquatic/shark)]

cardPool.title: 🦉 Owl Avian
cardPool.value: Owl Avian — humanoid bird, quiet, nocturnal, and perceptive beyond the visible. Exceptionally rare, the owlkin are among the wisest sages, often found in magical academies and other places of study. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (avian/owl)]

cardPool.title: 🦊 Foxkin (Kitsune)
cardPool.value: Foxkin (also known as Kitsune) — clever, elusive, and naturally charming, the kitsune are the most cunning and devious of the beastmen kind. Despite their alluring appearances, and natural charm, they evoke fear in equal measure as renowned masters of illusion magic and intrigue. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (vulpine)]

cardPool.title: 🦋 Bloomant
cardPool.value: Bloomant — cross between flowering plantoids and pollinating insectoids. They possess delicate wings dusted with luminous pollen that carries healing properties. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Plantoid × Insectoid)]

cardPool.title: 🦋 Myrrid
cardPool.value: Myrrid — cross of pollinating insectoids, sapient flora, and gentle spirits. They share hive empathy, floral scent-speech, and translucent soul-wings. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Insectoid × Plantoid × Spirit)]

cardPool.title: 🦌 Deerfolk
cardPool.value: Deerfolk — graceful, alert, and sensitive to shifts in the world around them, the deerfolk are one of the more serene beastmen species.  [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (cervine)]

cardPool.title: 🦍 Apefolk
