cardPool.value: Apefolk — strong, nimble beastmen built for climbing or grappling. Varied in appearance, from gorillas to common monkeys, the apefolk are a resilient species that prefers the natural, rural environments over cities. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (primate)]

cardPool.title: 🧌 Baseline Ogre
cardPool.value: Baseline Ogre — towering, brutish, and physically overwhelming, but slow to adapt. They are distant kin to both giants and trolls, and a middle step between them - not as strong or massive as the giants, but also more intelligent than the trolls. [Category: Living — Giantoid family]

cardPool.title: 🧌 Common Goblin
cardPool.value: Common Goblin - The most baseline variant of a goblin, common goblins are cunning, sneaky, and have an intrinsic love for gold (and other possessions), preferably belonging to someone else. [ Category: Living - Goblinoid family ]

cardPool.title: 🧑 Human
cardPool.value: Human — adaptable, balanced, and familiar to the world around them. [Category: Living — Humanoid family (baseline)]

cardPool.title: 🧝 Goblinar
cardPool.value: Goblinar - An extremely rare hybrid, the Goblinar are a result of union between any variation of elf, and any species of the goblinoid family. The result is a species that pairs grace and beauty of elves, with short stature and sneaky nature of goblins. [ Category: Living - Hybrid ]

cardPool.title: 🧟‍♀️ Lamia
cardPool.value: Lamia — serpentine from the waist down, with hypnotic presence and venomous charm. Their uniqueness comes from their mono-gendered nature - all Lamias appear in female forms, regardless of perceived gender.  [Category: Living — Beastfolk/Serpentine branch]

cardPool.title: 🧠 Linkborn
cardPool.value: Linkborn — networked individuals sharing fragments of memory and thought through mana relays. When separated, they hear faint echoes of their kin’s minds. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (networked/mana-link subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🧠 Mindcore
cardPool.value: Mindcore — a disembodied intelligence given shape through magic or machinery, the mindcores require no host to exist, forming their bodies through constant, background use of magic which they rely on to live. [Category: Non-living species — Artificial/Arcane cognition]

cardPool.title: 🧫 Oozeform
cardPool.value: Oozeform — industrial slimes created when alchemical waste absorbed mana and gained self. They mimic humanoid shape but retain soft, shifting anatomy. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (bio-alchemical/subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🧬 Flesh Abomination
cardPool.value: Flesh Abomination — patchwork creature created through necromantic grafting and experimental alchemy. Rarely self-aware, but those that gain souls become tragic familiars. [Category: Familiar — Casted/alchemical construct with soul]

cardPool.title: 🧬 Syntari
cardPool.value: Syntari — biomechanical hybrids where living tissue and enchanted metal merged completely. Their skin ripples between organic and mechanical form depending on stress. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (bio-mechanical/symbiote subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🧱 Clay Elemental
cardPool.value: Clay Elemental — soul awakened inside temple clay or river mud, typically near shrines where offerings decay. Soft, reparable, and highly moldable. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating inanimate matter (earth/clay)]

cardPool.title: 🧱 Rustborn
cardPool.value: Rustborn — descendants of corroded constructs and discarded war machines. Their bodies are patchworks of metal and memory, bleeding rust instead of blood. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (decay/scrap subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🧵 Petitoid Baseline
cardPool.value: Petitoid Baseline — umbrella term for short-statured, soul-bearing peoples that do not fit cleanly into dwarven, gnome, or halfling cultural molds. Used by scholars for mixed-village smallfolk. [Category: Living — Shortfolk (parvoid/petitoid baseline)]

cardPool.title: 🧵 Threadborn
cardPool.value: Threadborn — humanoids created from enchanted cloth and seam magic, animated long enough to dream. They maintain delicate patterns that change with mood. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (woven/enchanted textile subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🧸 Puppeteered Doll
cardPool.value: Puppeteered Doll — soft-bodied, enchanted, and full of hidden resilience. Not to be mistaken for puppet constructs, or dolls animated through other kinds of magic, the puppeteer dolls are sapient and independent species created through highest levels of puppeteer magic, placing them in the familiar species family - and unlike the misleading name of them or the magic that makes them, they are not actual puppets, and depending on the caster, can enjoy full free will. [Category: Familiar — Casted magic with soul]

cardPool.title: 🩶 Thrall
cardPool.value: Thrall — a half-awakened vampire servant, containing a fragment of its master's blood-soul. Often used as daytime agents and scouts. [Category: Living (soul-bound) — Undead family (lesser subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🩸 Dhampir
cardPool.value: Dhampir — offspring of vampire and human, balancing the hunger for blood with mortal restraint. They neither burn in sunlight nor age easily, making them eerie but pitiable kin. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Undead)]

cardPool.title: 🩸 Revenant
cardPool.value: Revenant — a returned soul anchored to its corpse by unfinished purpose. Unlike zombies or skeletons, revenants retain intellect, emotion, and memory but burn with obsession until their task is done. [Category: Living (soul-retaining) — Undead family (vengeful subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🩸 Sanguic Elemental
cardPool.value: Sanguic Elemental — rare entities formed where life-force magic condensed without a body to contain it. Their essence flows like liquid ruby, pulsing to a heartbeat of their own. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating life essence (Blood Magic)]

cardPool.title: 🩸 Sanguim
cardPool.value: Sanguim — infernal vampires whose blood burns like molten ruby. Their charm borders on hypnotic, but every wound they inflict glows faintly red-hot. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Undead × Demonoid)]

cardPool.title: 🪂 Rocborn
cardPool.value: Rocborn — towering avian beastfolk descended from sky-hunting megafauna. Larger and heavier than other avians, with strong weather instincts and gliding wings not meant for tight spaces. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (avian/giant)]

cardPool.title: 🪆 Arcane Mannequin
cardPool.value: Arcane Mannequin — casted, soul-bearing practice body used by academies; some awaken sentience and leave. [Category: Familiar — Casted/academic construct with soul]

cardPool.title: 🪓 Ograthi
cardPool.value: Ograthi — enormous hybrids of orc and giant lineage. Their bodies are thick with muscle and scars, yet they often display surprising tenderness toward smaller kin. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Orcoid × Giantoid)]

cardPool.title: 🪞 Gorgon
cardPool.value: Gorgon — serpentine-haired humanoids cursed or born with petrifying gaze. Modern gorgons learn control to live among mortals; the curse is innate, not infectious. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (cursed/ophidian)]

cardPool.title: 🪞 Mirage Elemental
cardPool.value: Mirage Elemental — illusion magic that gained permanence through self-belief. Their bodies appear different to every observer, yet cast no shadow of their own. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating illusion constructs (Illusion Magic)]

cardPool.title: 🪞 Mirrorling
cardPool.value: Mirrorling — dual-form shifters whose second body is a reflective, featureless copy used for infiltration. Unlike doppel, they do not copy targets, only switch to their neutral mirror state. [Category: Living — Lycanthrope family (dual-form/neutral)]

cardPool.title: 🪞 Phantarii
cardPool.value: Phantarii — illusion-born children of fae and mirage elementals. They create living mirages that echo their moods, blending art and deception seamlessly. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Fae × Elemental/Illusion)]

cardPool.title: 🪞 Vitric
cardPool.value: Vitric — glass-bodied artisans from enchanted foundries. Semi-transparent and heat-resistant, they shimmer with inner color when exposed to sunlight. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (glass/urban subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🪞 Vitron
cardPool.value: Vitron — humanoids formed when molten glass fused with decaying organics during failed experiments. Their bodies are translucent, their nerves visible like fractal veins. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (mutated/glass subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🪟 Glass Elemental
cardPool.value: Glass Elemental — a soul awakened inside fused sand and heat, forming a translucent, ringing body. Brittle to blunt force but highly resistant to magic. Appears mostly in deserts where wild mana vitrifies terrain. [Category: Elemental — Spontaneous magic animating inanimate matter (glass/silica)]

cardPool.title: 🪨 Baseline Troll
cardPool.value: Baseline Troll — tough, knotted, and regenerative. Their body heals faster than it breaks, and their mind is slower but deeply rooted in instinct. [Category: Living — Giantoid family (troll branch)]

cardPool.title: 🪨 Delverkin
cardPool.value: Delverkin — sturdy and insightful, these hybrids of dwarves and elves carry endurance tempered by intuition. They often serve as master architects or miners of enchanted stone. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Elvenoid × Shortfolk/Dwarven)]

cardPool.title: 🪨 Goliath
cardPool.value: Goliath — born of giant and mortal parents, marked by mottled skin and immense strength. Despite towering physiques, they often seek solitude and purpose beyond brute power. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Giantoid)]

cardPool.title: 🪨 Soulforged
cardPool.value: Soulforged — the descendants of the first golems to gain true sentience. They are living stone or steel bearing inherited souls, forever balancing machine logic with emotion. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (artifice/soul subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🪫 Wireghost
cardPool.value: Wireghost — humanoids made from broken projection spells left to decay. They phase through walls, their forms made of light strands shaped like muscle fiber. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (projection/ghost subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🪬 Mummy
cardPool.value: Mummy — embalmed dead bound by oaths or curses. Their souls are tethered through ritual wrappings and guardian sigils, giving them endurance unmatched among the dead. [Category: Living (soul-bound) — Undead family (ritual subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🪰 Marsh Hag Fae
cardPool.value: Marsh Hag Fae — unseelie-aligned fae manifesting as old, moss-draped crones, guarding fenland secrets and holding bargains over travelers. [Category: Living — Fae family (Unseelie/marsh)]

cardPool.title: 🪱 Marrowfen
cardPool.value: Marrowfen — swamp-born humanoids who coexist with decay. Their skin secretes protective oils, and they carry fungal symbionts that glow faintly when threatened. [Category: Living — Terragen family (swamp/decay subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🪴 Vineborn
cardPool.value: Vineborn — carnivorous plantoids with tendrils that can bloom into grasping limbs. They are polite, cultured, and often terrifyingly calm during hunts. [Category: Living — Plantoid family (carnivorous subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🪵 Bog Numen
cardPool.value: Bog Numen — slow, moss-draped spirits born from wetlands and forgotten marsh altars. They are protective, but alien in priorities. [Category: Spirit — Nature/wetland spirits]

cardPool.title: 🪶 Corvid Fae
cardPool.value: Corvid Fae — trickster-aligned fae with glossy feathers and a taste for secrets, sitting between Seelie and Unseelie courts as information brokers. [Category: Living — Fae family (Unseelie-leaning corvid)]

cardPool.title: 🪶 Inkborn
cardPool.value: Inkborn — beings conjured when arcane manuscripts absorbed too much life energy. Their skin bears moving glyphs, and their words literally shape the world. [Category: Living — Technomagical family (linguistic/spell subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🪶 Pixie
cardPool.value: Pixie — small, winged, and full of chaotic curiosity and trickery. The most mischievous among the fae family, pixies make a living through the pixie dust trade - their biggest natural advantage in the civilized world. [Category: Living — Fae family (Seelie, lesser fae)]

cardPool.title: 🪸 Coral Merfolk
cardPool.value: Coral merfolk — vibrant, reef-attuned, and pulsing with latent magic, Coral merfolk are one of the most jovial and carefree species. Their societies are mostly recognized for near-endless festivals and jubilant atmosphere. [Category: Living — Aquatic/Humanoid family (merfolk lineage, coral)]

cardPool.title: 🪸 Coralith
cardPool.value: Coralith — marine-adapted humanoids born among coral reefs infused with leyflow. Their skin carries natural chitin plates patterned like coral fans. [Category: Living — Terragen family (marine/coral subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🪸 Kelpborn
cardPool.value: Kelpborn — aquatic plantoids resembling humanoid seaweed, floating through shallows with effortless grace. They sustain themselves by photosynthesis and saltwater nutrients. [Category: Living — Plantoid family (aquatic/algal subtype)]

cardPool.title: 🪸 Tidecryst
cardPool.value: Tidecryst — descendants of crystal terragen and coraliths, forming radiant underwater societies lit by refracted mana. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Terragen/Crystalline × Terragen/Coral)]

cardPool.title: 🪽 Harpy
cardPool.value: Harpy — winged humanoids with taloned feet and keen eyesight, descended from avian spirits. Unlike full avians, their wings sprout from arms rather than shoulders, balancing flight with dexterity. [Category: Living — Beastfolk family (avian/harpy)]

cardPool.title: 🫧 Gelborn
cardPool.value: Gelborn — soft-bodied mortals with trace slime ancestry. Their bodies are flexible and semi-stable, allowing minor reshaping under emotion or stress. [Category: Living — Hybrid (Humanoid × Slime/Amorphous)]

cardPool.title: 🐜 Mundane
cardPool.value: Your power is ordinary to native inhabitants of the world you arrive in. If the world has magic, your magic is average.

cardPool.title: 🪶 Minor
cardPool.value: Your power is barely above average citizen.

cardPool.title: ⚔️ Competent
cardPool.value: Your power is strong enough to be slightly above an average native.

cardPool.title: 🔮 Attuned
cardPool.value: Your power is in sync with the world's rules, and depends on your further relationship with universal powers.

cardPool.title: 🔥 Gifted
cardPool.value: Your power is on a very high level, among the world's elite, but below most dangerous threats.

cardPool.title: 💫 Heroic
cardPool.value: Your power is on a level of a hero, stronger than most mortals and able to take on most dangerous threats.

cardPool.title: ⚡ Awakened
cardPool.value: Your power is something that has been considered lost, impossible, or otherwise not available in the world you arrive in.

cardPool.title: 🌪️ Mystery
cardPool.value: Your power is completely unrelated to the world you arrive in.

cardPool.title: 🕳️ Null/Weak
cardPool.value: You possess no measurable power. You are weaker than most inhabitants.

cardPool.title: 💥 Overloaded
cardPool.value: Your power exceeds safe limits. High output but unstable and risky.

cardPool.title: 💀 Cursed
cardPool.value: Your power is strong but comes with a constant drawback or cost.

cardPool.title: 🧩 Unquantifiable
cardPool.value: Your power cannot be measured. Effects are inconsistent and unpredictable.

cardPool.title: 🖥️ Glitched
cardPool.value: Your power behaves erratically and may break normal rules.

cardPool.title: 🪞 Adaptive
cardPool.value: Your power scales with how others perceive you.

cardPool.title: ⚖️ Unstable/Changing
cardPool.value: Your power fluctuates between weak and strong states.

cardPool.title: 🌀 Transcendent
cardPool.value: Your power ignores normal limits and system rules.

cardPool.title: 👁️ Godlike
cardPool.value: You possess overwhelming power compared to most beings - but within the universal laws.

cardPool.title: 📜 Reality-altering
cardPool.value: Your presence alters how power and rules function around you.

cardPool.title: 🩸 Forbidden
cardPool.value: Your power is extremely strong but outlawed, taboo or otherwise unacceptable to use.

cardPool.title: 🪶 Unlimited Potential
cardPool.value: Your power starts humble, but has no fixed limit and depends entirely on growth.

cardPool.title: 📊 Level-Based World
cardPool.value: This world runs on visible levels, stats, and skills. Growth follows experience points and rank-ups.

cardPool.title: 🌤️ Divine Overseer System
cardPool.value: A divine overseer manages reality directly. Quests, miracles, and punishments come from the same celestial source.

cardPool.title: ♻️ Reincarnation Loop
cardPool.value: When someone dies, they respawn at a save point or are reborn with memory intact. The cycle continues until success.

cardPool.title: 🕹️ RPG Interface World
cardPool.value: The world operates like an RPG. Menus, inventories, and skills are standard parts of daily life.

cardPool.title: ⚔️ Hero-Demon Cycle
cardPool.value: Summoned heroes and demon lords appear in cycles. Once the balance breaks, the cycle resets itself.

cardPool.title: 🕯️ Blessing System
cardPool.value: Blessings, curses, and divine contracts define power. Everything traces back to a patron or deity.

cardPool.title: 💻 Magic Code Framework
cardPool.value: Magic is calculated like programming. Spells run on formulas, elements, or mana codes.

cardPool.title: 🏷️ Title Mechanics
cardPool.value: Titles carry power. Gaining or losing one immediately changes stats and reputation.

cardPool.title: 🧠 Soul Archive System
cardPool.value: Souls are treated as data. Memories, skills, and even personality can be transferred or copied.

cardPool.title: 🧿 Legend Power Rule
cardPool.value: Power scales by fame and story weight. The more legendary your name, the stronger you become.

cardPool.title: 🔮 Karma Meter
cardPool.value: A visible karma meter adjusts luck and fate based on deeds. Even small acts shift fortune immediately.

cardPool.title: 📜 Quest-Driven Reality
cardPool.value: Reality assigns quests automatically. Fulfilling them shapes destiny and unlocks hidden paths.

cardPool.title: 🎁 Gift Core System
cardPool.value: Every individual carries a unique skill called a Gift, often absurdly specific or overpowered.

cardPool.title: ⏳ Time Displacement Field
cardPool.value: Time moves differently across regions. Days or centuries may pass elsewhere while moments pass here.

cardPool.title: 🩸 Power Absorption Rule
cardPool.value: Defeating strong foes lets you absorb fragments of their power or abilities.

cardPool.title: 🌍 Expanding World Engine
cardPool.value: The world expands through exploration. New lands, races, and dungeons generate once discovered.

cardPool.title: 📚 Knowledge Mana Theory
cardPool.value: Knowledge itself carries mana. Reading, studying, or remembering strengthens magical potential.

cardPool.title: 💀 Drop Loot Reality
cardPool.value: Death leaves loot, experience, or essence that anyone can collect, encouraging endless conflict.

cardPool.title: 🧩 Patch Notes Universe
cardPool.value: Reality updates periodically. New laws, species, or balance patches appear after each era.

cardPool.title: 🎭 Narrative Pressure System
cardPool.value: Everything that exists must entertain. Worlds, gods, and monsters evolve to keep the story interesting.

cardPool.title: 🚫 No System
cardPool.value: This world has no visible system, no interface, and no divine mechanics. Actions have natural consequences only.

cardPool.title: Human
cardPool.value: Regular, baseline human by the most common definition of human.
